summary: Update 12:15 pm MYT: more finals - Thunder beat Cleveland 124-116 (Shai 42), Pacers upset Memphis 107-103, and Minnesota won 117-107 at Houston per a VAVEL recap; a Nets 114-104 win over Charlotte was reported but not fully confirmed. Spurs led Dallas 68-51 at halftime (Wembanyama 29 by the break). Lakers-Kings and Heat-Clippers are live but I could not find a reliable live score or live price, and Jazz-Pelicans, Raptors-Nuggets and Blazers-Suns results were not found, so those keep earlier estimates. No picks this check. Next news: tonight's (US Thursday) slate injury reports, with lineups about 30 min before the first tip on Friday morning MYT.
